name: Invisible Stalker
languages: Auran, understands Common but doesn't speak

traits.name: Air Form
traits.text: The stalker can enter an enemy’s space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Invisibility
traits.text: The stalker has the Invisible condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The stalker makes three Wind Swipe at- tacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Vortex.

actions.name: Wind Swipe
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Force damage.

actions.name: Vortex
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, one Large or smaller creature in the stalker’s space. Failure: 7 (1d8 + 3) Thunder damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Until the grapple ends, the target can’t cast spells with a Verbal component and
